Lunar orbiter to be deployed in lunar orbit by ispace lunar lander-3.
Description

Lunar orbiter to be deployed in lunar orbit by ispace lunar lander-3. Hex20 provides the spacecraft bus and the mission will carry the LASP built High Energy Relativistic Telescope to measure solar protons and electrons in cislunar orbit, especially after solar flares. These measurements are crucial for quantifying the space weather environment around the moon to facilitate future human exploration of the moon. We will present preliminary design of both missions and current status of development in this presentation.
